gloss: to curse, to put a curse on

definitions.gloss: to curse, to put a curse on, to hex
definitions.explanation: To invoke supernatural harm upon someone, or to wish ill upon them. Can refer to literal supernatural curses or strong feelings of resentment.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{運命|うんめい}を{呪|のろ}った。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{裏切|うらぎ}った{相手|あいて}を{呪|のろ}った。
examples.english: She cursed the person who betrayed her.

examples.japanese: {呪|のろ}われた{屋敷|やしき}には{誰|だれ}も{近|ちか}づかない。
examples.english: Nobody goes near the cursed mansion.

notes:
The related noun {呪|のろ}い means 'curse.' This word appears frequently in horror, folklore, and fantasy contexts, but is also used figuratively to express deep resentment (e.g., cursing one's fate or bad luck).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{呪|のろ}いをかける — to cast a curse
・{呪|のろ}いを{解|と}く — to break a curse
・{運命|うんめい}を{呪|のろ}う — to curse one's fate
・{呪|のろ}われた{場所|ばしょ} — cursed place

RELATED WORDS:
・{呪|のろ}い — curse (noun)
・{呪文|じゅもん} — spell, incantation
・{祟|たた}り — divine curse, retribution
